description: This file defines the 'SortMenu' React functional component, which provides a dropdown-like sorting menu for notes. It manages its open/close state, displays the current selected sort option, and allows selection of different sort criteria, communicating changes via callback.

methods.name: SortMenu
methods.description: React functional component rendering a sort menu with options based on 'SortOption' enum, handling toggle open/close state and selection callbacks.
